def create_secure_ssl_context(
    cafile: Optional[str] = None,
    capath: Optional[str] = None,
    cadata: Optional[str] = None,
    minimum_version: int = ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1_2,
    maximum_version: int = ssl.TLSVersion.MAXIMUM_SUPPORTED,
    verify_mode: int = ssl.CERT_REQUIRED,
    check_hostname: bool = True,
) -> ssl.SSLContext:
    context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT)
    try:
        context.minimum_version = minimum_version
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    try:
        context.maximum_version = maximum_version
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    context.verify_mode = verify_mode
    context.check_hostname = check_hostname
    if cafile or capath or cadata:
        context.load_verify_locations(cafile=cafile, capath=capath, cadata=cadata)
    else:
        context.load_default_certs()
    try:
        context.options |= ssl.OP_NO_COMPRESSION
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    try:
        context.options &= ~ssl.OP_LEGACY_SERVER_CONNECT
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    try:
        context.set_ciphers("HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5:!RC4:!DES")
    except ssl.SSLError:
        pass
    return context

def establish_ssl_connection(host, port, context=None, timeout=10.0, server_hostname=None):
    if context is None: context = create_secure_ssl_context()
    if server_hostname is None: server_hostname = host
    raw_socket = socket.create_connection((host, int(port)), timeout=timeout)
    try:
       ssl_socket = context.wrap_socket(raw_socket, server_hostname=server_hostname)
    except Exception:
       raw_socket.close()
       raise
    return ssl_socket

def _parse_http_response(raw):
   if b'\r\n\r\n' not in raw: raise ValueError
   header_blob, body = raw.split(b'\r\n\r\n',1)
   lines = header_blob.split(b'\r\n')
   status_line = lines[0].decode('latin-1')
   parts=status_line.split(' ',2)
   version=parts[0]; status=int(parts[1]); reason=parts[2] if len>2 else ''
   headers={}
   for line in lines[1:]:
      if not line: continue
      name, value = line.split(b':',1)
      headers[name.decode('latin-1').lower()] = value.decode('latin-1').strip()
   # handle chunked
   if headers.get('transfer-encoding','').lower() == 'chunked':
       decoded=[]; pos=0
       while pos < len(body):
          end=body.find(b'\r\n', pos)
          if end == -1: break
          size_line=body[pos:end].split(b';')[0]
          try: size=int(size_line,16)
          except ValueError: break
          pos=end+2
          if size==0: break
          decoded.append(body[pos:pos+size])
          pos += size
          # skip CRLF after chunk
          if body[pos:pos+2] == b'\r\n': pos +=2
          else: pos = body.find(b'\r\n', pos)+2? Simpler.
       body=b''.join(decoded)
   return {'status':status, 'reason':reason, 'headers':headers, 'body':body.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}
